description:
PRINCIPAL direction (2026-06-01): two linked insights.

INSIGHT 1 (framing, confirmed by direct observation this session): the Stoa gauntlet IS a version of agent teams with MORE CONTROL. Precise: it spans TWO primitives — the tier layer (POLYBIUS<->floor-manager<->PLINY, separate long-running sessions coordinating via bw-as-shared-task-list) is AGENT-TEAMS-shaped; the CAPTAIN layer (PLINY->DAEDALUS/ARGUS/...) is SUBAGENTS-shaped. The 'more control' = the substrate (role files + disciplines + canonized pipeline order + HARD STOP gates + three-tier independence + verdict formats). A workflow = the same gauntlet with control moved INTO CODE instead of PLINY's judgment. So the four primitives are a control-vs-flexibility spectrum of one idea, not rivals.

INSIGHT 2 (the direction): make workflows one of the things the TEAM knows how to make, when to recommend, and how to set up + run. Decomposes into THREE parts:
1. HOW TO MAKE -> the workflow-composer skill (stoa--04n, already scoped).
2. WHEN TO RECOMMEND -> a TOOL-SELECTION discipline (the real gap). The team routes a task across the WHOLE repertoire: subagents / skills / agent-teams / workflow / full gauntlet / Mode-2 pairing. Workflows JOIN the repertoire; routing judgment is the new capability. This makes POLYBIUS a TOOL-SELECTOR (route HOW work is structured), not just a router (route WHO does it) — operational sibling to 'where is human attention required'. The task-shape taxonomy already drafted in docs/sessions/2026-05-30-stoa-workflows-integration-strategy.md (the 8-row coding+non-coding table) IS this logic — promote it from session doc to routing canon.
3. HOW TO SET UP + RUN -> operational know-how (belongs in the composer skill): pre-allowlist commands (stoa--x4j stall-fix), args for reuse, 'cost: run a small slice first', save-for-reuse (.claude/workflows vs ~/.claude/workflows), overnight=remote-routine-not-workflow.

OPEN: where #2 (tool-selection discipline) lives — a new operating-disciplines section? a POLYBIUS §? — and whether it's one arc with stoa--04n or sequenced after. Cross-ref: stoa--04n (composer), stoa--h2z (remediation-workflow), stoa--aox (discipline-enforcement), strategy doc (taxonomy). N=0 design.
